title: The support of an integer multiplicity current is the support of its weight measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of T in U with weight μ_T = R.measure = θH^n⌞M. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P: x ∈ spt T if and only if x ∈ U and μ_T(B_r(x)) > 0 for every r > 0. Here spt T (T.support) is U minus the union of all open W with W̄ compact, W̄ ⊆ U, and T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with spt ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ x : Euclid P, x ∈ T.support ↔ x ∈ U ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < R.measure (ball x r)
